# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>; Mr. Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

He twirls his mustache and casts romantic glances toward Sukey Pullen.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He uses sarcasm with his students and shows a lack of discipline in the classroom, preferring to focus on older pupils or personal distractions. He is known to harbour romantic feelings and write poetry. He can be affected during emotional moments, such as his departure from Brierley school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Traits

- infatuated with Sukey Pullen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)</sub>
- sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- inclined to write poetry  <sub>[v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068)</sub>

## Abilities

- clarifying coursework in Latin and algebra  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)</sub>
- reciting dramatic speeches  <sub>[v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040)</sub>

## Goals

- court Sukey Pullen and assist her with her studies for the Regent’s Academy entrance exam  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- prepare older pupils for Regent's examinations  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school, where his teaching methods and discipline were criticized by locals and students alike. He spent much of his time attending to older students, particularly Sukey Pullen, with whom he was infatuated, often writing messages on her slate or explaining algebra and Latin to her while ignoring the rest of the class. During his tenure, he punished Nell Harcourt after she broke a slate over Hugh Carrow's head for calling her 'Carrots', forcing her to stand before the blackboard under a written reprimand. On another occasion, he punished Nell for arriving late alongside the boys by forcing her to sit next to Hugh Carrow. Pidgeon also performed Mark Antony's address from Shakespeare at a Debating Club concert in Brierley. After finishing his term at Brierley school, he delivered an emotional farewell speech to the students, leaving some pupils in tears, before departing the community.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Lodged at the residence of Eben Duckett while teaching at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Secured his position as schoolmaster because his uncle was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
